title: 第7章 家族检验开始第8章 家族检验就这
content_zh:
家族检验当天早上，叶非凡难得的没有进行早上的修炼，而是选择好好的睡到自然醒，然后就直接去到父母的房前。
“咚，咚，咚“
“父亲早，母亲早，我是叶非凡，我可以进来吗？”
“进来吧”里面传来母亲孙素素的声音。
“你来我们这还敲什么门啊，直接进来就可以了，又不是外人。”孙素素看着刚进来的叶非凡说道。
“我这不是怕突然进来，打扰到您们二位了吗。”叶非凡看着母亲孙素素笑着说道。
“叶虎，你看你儿子他说的什么话，怎么年纪越大，反而越来越客气了”
“哈哈哈，儿子长大了嘛，肯定还是要注意点的，毕竟不是小孩了，再说了，我们也都不能随便去他的房间了，这小子来我们这，肯定也得有点规矩。”叶虎倒是没有在意这些，反而帮助叶非凡说道。
“你今天不是要去参加家族的检测吗，怎么现在还来找我们，是还在担心修为上面的事情吗？”叶虎看着叶非凡继续说道。
“担心是有点担心，不过还好，已经做好心理准备了，今天过来主要还是想知道父亲和母亲你们会不会一起参加这个家族检验。”
“我会去参加，但是你母亲还是要去商铺那边，毕竟那边不能完全空着，还是要有人坐镇。”
“啊，母亲去商铺那边吗？可是她没有修为，如何坐镇”叶非凡有点惊讶，他原本以为这次家族检验，要么父亲母亲都会参加，要么父亲母亲都不参加，毕竟商铺那边的确很重要，但没想到是母亲身为一个普通人要去商会那边坐镇。
此时，孙素素笑着说道
“非凡你想哪去了，我去商铺坐镇又不是要去比武切磋什么的，只是帮忙处理一些商铺中的事情，平常我都是和你父亲一起在商铺那边处理的，只是今天特殊情况，就暂时由我一个人去处理了，不过也就一天，不会有什么大的问题，况且商铺中还有护卫队长叶飞在那，他可是我们一起共事了好几年，算是老下属了，有什么事情他也能处理。”
“那看来还是我阅历太浅了，不太懂这方面的事情，以后还得跟着父亲和母亲学习学习才是。”叶非凡继续扮演着一个好的儿子。
“嗯，你这么一说也是了，有空多来商铺这边，跟着我和你母亲学习学习，以后如果真的推荐你来做这个管事的时候，也好有些理由，免得其他的长老们说些闲话。”叶虎被这么一提醒，突然想起给叶非凡安排点事情。
“好的，我知道了”叶非凡老实的答应，毕竟这条路也是之前考虑过的路线之一。
“非凡，你吃了早饭没。”孙素素问道。
“还没有。”
“那正好，咱们就一起吃吧，反正你母亲也是要吃早饭的。”叶虎说罢便对着门口的侍女说道

“把早餐端上来吧，准备三人份的。”
“好的”侍女随即将早餐拿到房中。
……
一家三口其乐融融的吃完早饭后，孙素素便离去，前往叶家商铺坐镇去了，而叶虎和叶非凡则一起走向叶家演武场，准备参加三年一度的家族检验。
来到演武场，只见高台上已经有几个长老或者管事入座了，但主位上的叶家家主和叶家老祖则还未到场，此时演武台周围则陆陆续续有年轻一辈的叶家子弟来到这里。
“听说叶飞扬大哥现在已经练气十一重了，这可真是厉害啊，跟我年纪差不多大，我才练气七重，看来叶飞扬大哥就是下任家主了。”
“是啊，也不知道这次检测，叶飞扬大哥会不会来个爆发，直接突破到练气十二重，要是那样，就不仅是在咱们叶家，放在辉月城也是很有潜力的天才了。”
“好像冯家和城主府那边也有练气十一重的年轻一辈，倒是练气十二重的年轻一辈还没有听到过，不知道这个辉月城年轻一辈第一人到底是谁。”
“对啊，这第一人的称号，要是能在咱们叶家多好，最有希望的肯定就是叶飞扬大哥了。”
“叶兴怀好是练气九重，叶凝霜也有练气八重，嫡系里面这一辈还是有点东西的啊。”
“毕竟是嫡系，在修炼丹药方面肯定会比我们要好一些吧，不过咱也不要气馁，和叶飞扬大哥比，我们比不过，但是和叶兴怀和叶凝霜相比，咱们还是有希望的。”
“可以，兄弟你这志向大。看起来这次检测后你要上去挑战一番？”
“哈哈哈，也许吧，到时候在看。”
“喂喂，你这怎么一下子怂了。”
“欸，那没有，我只是说到时候再看而已，又没说不挑战。”
content_en:
On the morning of the family examination, Ye Feifan rarely did any morning exercises. Instead, he chose to sleep well until he woke up naturally, and then went directly to his parents' house.
"Boom, boom, boom"
"Good morning, father, good morning, mother. I am Ye Feifan, can I come in?"
"Come in" came the voice of mother Sun Susu from inside.
"Why did you knock on the door when you came to our place? Just come in directly. You are not an outsider." Sun Susu said looking at Ye Feifan who had just entered.
"Aren't I afraid of coming in suddenly and disturbing you two?" Ye Feifan looked at his mother Sun Susu and said with a smile.
"Ye Hu, look at what your son said. The older he gets, the more polite he becomes."
"Hahaha, my son has grown up, so he must be more careful. After all, he is not a child anymore. Besides, we can't just go to his room. This kid must have some rules when he comes to our place." Ye Hu didn't care about this, but helped Ye Feifan.
"Aren't you going to take part in the family test today? Why are you still coming to us now? Are you still worried about your cultivation?" Ye Hu looked at Ye Feifan and continued.
"I'm a little worried, but fortunately, I'm mentally prepared. The main reason I came here today is to know whether father and mother will participate in this family test together."
"I will go to participate, but your mother still has to go to the store. After all, it cannot be completely empty there, and someone still needs to be there."
"Ah, is mother going to the store? But she has no cultivation, how can she sit in charge?" Ye Feifan was a little surprised. He originally thought that in this family test, either his father and mother would participate, or neither mother and father would participate. After all, the store was indeed very important, but he did not expect that his mother, as an ordinary person, would go to the chamber of commerce to sit in charge.
At this time, Sun Susu said with a smile
"Feifan, where are you thinking? I'm not going to compete in martial arts or anything like that. I'm just helping to deal with some things in the store. I usually handle it with your father at the store. But today is a special situation, so I will handle it by myself for the time being. It's only for one day, so there won't be any big problems. Besides, there is also the guard captain Ye Fei in the store. We have worked together for several years. He is an old subordinate. He can handle anything."
"It seems that my experience is too inexperienced and I don't know much about this aspect. I will have to learn from my father and mother in the future." Ye Feifan continued to play the role of a good son.
"Well, that's what you said. Come to the store more often when you have time and learn from your mother and me. If I really recommend you to be the manager in the future, there will be some reasons to prevent other elders from gossiping." Ye Hu was reminded of this and suddenly thought of arranging something for Ye Feifan.
"Okay, I understand." Ye Feifan agreed honestly. After all, this road was one of the routes he had considered before.
"Fei Fei, have you had breakfast?" Sun Susu asked.
"Not yet."
"That's good, let's eat together. Your mother also wants to have breakfast anyway." After Ye Hu said this, he said to the maid at the door.
"Bring breakfast here, for three people."
"Okay" The maid then brought the breakfast to the room.
…
After the family of three had a happy breakfast, Sun Susu left and went to the Ye family store to sit down, while Ye Hu and Ye Feifan walked to the Ye family martial arts arena together to prepare for the triennial family examination.
When I arrived at the martial arts arena, I saw that several elders or stewards were already seated on the high platform, but the head of the Ye family and the ancestor of the Ye family who were in charge were not there yet. At this time, the younger generation of Ye family disciples were arriving one after another around the martial arts arena.
"I heard that Brother Ye Feiyang has now reached the eleventh level of Qi training. This is really amazing. He is about the same age as me.How old I am, I am only at the seventh level of Qi training. It seems that Brother Ye Feiyang will be the next head of the family. "
"Yeah, I don't know if Brother Ye Feiyang will explode in this test and directly break through to the twelfth level of Qi training. If so, he will be a genius with great potential not only in our Ye family, but also in Huiyue City. "
"It seems that the Feng family and the City Lord's Mansion also have young people who are practicing at the eleventh level, but I haven't heard of the young people who are practicing at the twelfth level. I don't know who the number one young person in Huiyue City is. "
"Yes, it would be great if this title of number one could be in our Ye family. The most promising one would definitely be Brother Ye Feiyang. "
"Ye Xinghuai is at the ninth level of Qi training, and Ye Ningshuang is at the eighth level of Qi training. There is something good about this generation in the direct lineage. "
"After all, they are direct descendants, so they will definitely be better than us in cultivating elixirs, but we should not be discouraged. Compared with brother Ye Feiyang, we cannot compare, but compared with Ye Xinghuai and Ye Ningshuang, we still have hope. "
"Okay, brother, you have great ambitions. It seems like you are going to challenge yourself after this test? "
"Hahaha, maybe, I'll watch it then. "
"Hey, why are you so scared all of a sudden? "
"Hey, no, I just said we'll see when the time comes, and I didn't say I wouldn't challenge. "
